easy.q: How many High School Musical movies did Zac Efron star in?
easy.fact: The first one premiered on Disney Channel in January 2006.

easy.q: Julius Caesar was assassinated on the Ides of March. What day of March is that?
easy.fact: Caesar was stabbed in 44 BC at a meeting of the Roman Senate.

easy.q: When it's noon in Los Angeles, it's 3 p.m. in New York. How many hours apart are they?
easy.fact: The contiguous U.S. spans four standard time zones.

easy.q: How many minutes long is a standard round in pro boxing?
easy.fact: Boxers get a one-minute rest between rounds.

easy.q: How many squares are on a tic-tac-toe board?
easy.fact: In Britain the game is often called noughts and crosses.

medium.q: How many career home runs did Babe Ruth hit?
medium.fact: His record stood until Hank Aaron passed it in 1974.

medium.q: How many seasons did Brooklyn Nine-Nine run?
medium.fact: NBC picked up the show a day after Fox canceled it in 2018.

medium.q: How tall is Japan's Mount Fuji, to the nearest foot?
medium.fact: Fuji is an active volcano; it last erupted in 1707.

medium.q: How old was Cleopatra when she died in 30 BC?
medium.fact: She lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.

medium.q: How tall is London's Elizabeth Tower, home of Big Ben, in feet?
medium.fact: Big Ben is the name of the great bell inside, not the tower.

hard.q: To the nearest million, how many copies did Wii Sports sell?
hard.fact: It came bundled with the Wii in most regions, starting in 2006.

hard.q: To the nearest 10 feet, how long was the airship Hindenburg?
hard.fact: It was more than three times as long as a Boeing 747.

hard.q: How many games in a row did UConn women's basketball win in its record streak that ended in 2017?
hard.fact: Mississippi State ended it on a buzzer-beater in the Final Four.

hard.q: How tall is Yosemite Falls in total, from top to bottom, in feet?
hard.fact: It's made of three sections: Upper Fall, middle cascades and Lower Fall.
